mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_task ( task_biz_id, task_name, task_type_code, executor_type, wait_strategy, creator, assignee, priority, status, sub_status, failure_reason, session_id, version, parent_id, parent_execution_round, root_id, execution_round, input_data, output_data, wakeup_context, scheduled_time, start_time, end_time, expire_time, retry_count, max_retry, error_msg, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskBizId}, #{taskName}, #{taskTypeCode}, #{executorType}, #{waitStrategy, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{creator}, #{assignee}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{subStatus}, #{failureReason}, #{sessionId}, #{version}, #{parentId}, #{parentExecutionRound}, #{rootId}, #{executionRound}, #{inputData}, #{outputData}, #{wakeupContext}, #{scheduledTime}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{expireTime}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetry}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_task SET task_biz_id = #{taskBizId}, status = #{status}, sub_status = #{subStatus}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, session_id = #{sessionId}, input_data = #{inputData}, output_data = #{outputData}, wakeup_context = #{wakeupContext}, scheduled_time = #{scheduledTime}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, execution_round = #{executionRound}, parent_execution_round = #{parentExecutionRound}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_task WHERE task_biz_id = #{taskBizId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_task WHERE status = 'RETRYING' AND scheduled_time IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_time <= NOW() ORDER BY priority DESC, scheduled_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
